scope: Node in-memory Google service doubles; no real mail, Sheets, quota or deployment

checks.name: Happy path preserves columns, recipient and real newlines
Durable duplicate protection survives a new execution
ID reused for different content is rejected
Legacy rows are adopted without a second email
Send exception before delivery is not automatically retried
Uncertain delivery cannot generate a duplicate email
Failure to commit SENT remains uncertain and cannot resend
Write failure never calls MailApp and releases lock
Quota exhaustion still records feedback without mailing
Quota service failure preserves record without claiming delivery
Minute admission limit rejects new feedback
Daily limit remains enforced across minutes and resets on UTC day
Duplicate does not consume another admission slot
Concurrent/reentrant request cannot enter locked sender
Busy lock creates no rows or emails
Honeypot exits without accessing Sheets or Mail
Formula and control-prefixed cells are stored as text
URL query and fragment are not retained in Sheet or email
Reject empty content
Reject oversized content
Reject oversized extra
Reject invalid ID
Reject unknown page
Reject subject header injection
Reject invalid timestamp
Reject HTTP URL
Reject host lookalike
Reject URL credentials
Reject recipient override
Duplicate form parameters are rejected
Oversized request is rejected before writing
Unexpected JSON content type is rejected
Impossible calendar date is rejected
Control characters in source URLs are rejected
Email misconfiguration does not leak raw values
Bound spreadsheet absence fails closed
Corrupt rate state is not silently reset
Existing header mismatch is not overwritten
Editor setup check reads only and exposes no private values
